{{Removed|date = 10th of February 2024}} {{For|the [[Golden Body Guard]]|[[Golden Body Guards 1]]|its normal counterpart, the [[Body Guards 2]]}} {{UnitInfobox |title1 = Golden Body Guards |image1 = GGuards2.png |source = [[Golden Crook Boss]] |type = Humanoid |health = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]50 |spawnrate = [[File:VehicleSpawn.png|20px|Spawnrate]]35s |damage_type = Single
Collision |ranged_damage = [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]]4 |ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]0.175 |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]25 |speed = 4 |hidden = No |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} (Collision only) |flying = No }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Golden Body Guards 2''' was a [[Units|unit]] spawned by the [[Golden Crook Boss]] at Level 4. In the game, the '''Golden Body Guards 2''' was referred to as just '''Body Guards''', though it has been referenced here as '''Golden Body Guards 2''' to differentiate itself from other [[Crook Boss]] and [[Golden Crook Boss]] units. As with other [[units]], it started from the end of the map path and moved towards the entrance of the map. Whenever there was an enemy in its range, the '''Golden Body Guards 2''' would stop moving to shoot at the enemies. It would continue walking when there were no enemies left in its range. The '''Golden Body Guards 2''' had a spawnrate of 35 seconds. There was a limit of three units per [[Golden Crook Boss]] at Level 4, limiting the amount of '''Golden Body Guards 2s''' it could spawn. ==Appearance== |-|First Body Guard = The body guard to the left of the direction of movement had pale skin. It had black legs and buttoned tuxedo with a yellow undershirt and sleeves with brown outlines. It also wore a red necktie, grey shades, black fedora with a red stripe, grey shoes and brown cotton gloves. It was faceless. The body guard wielded an [[wp:Thompson submachine gun|M1A1 Thompson]]. |-|Second Body Guard = The body guard to the right of the direction of movement had pale skin. It had black legs and buttoned tuxedo with a yellow undershirt and sleeves with brown outlines. It also wore a blue necktie, grey shades, and grey shoes. It has a brown beard. It is also faceless. The body guard wields an [[wp:Thompson submachine gun|M1A1 Thompson]]. ==Strategy== *You should not rely too much on the '''Golden Body Guards 2''' because of its slow spawnrate. *You will need to wait 35 seconds for a '''Golden Body Guards 2''' to spawn if you place down a [[Crook Boss]] and immediately upgrade it to Level 4. *The '''Golden Body Guards 2''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with [[defense]], like the [[Giant Boss]]. **However, the '''Golden Body Guards 2's''' ranged damage is still affected by enemies with [[defense]]. *The '''Golden Body Guards 2''' cannot detect [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] and [[Flying]] enemies, but they can still be damaged when the '''Golden Body Guards 2''' collides with them. However, this is likely unfavorable as the '''Golden Body Guards 2's''' damage comes primarily from firing at enemies rather than collision. **The [[Ace Pilot]] cannot give the '''Golden Body Guards 2''' hidden detection. **The '''Golden Body Guards 2''' cannot collide with ghost enemies, like the [[Soul]]. *On maps with multiple paths, only one '''Golden Body Guards 2''' will spawn per Level 4 [[Golden Crook Boss]]. **The '''Golden Body Guards 2''' will go down a random path. *The '''Golden Body Guards 2''' will struggle against fast enemies, like the [[Shock]] or [[Glitch]], as they can run into the '''Golden Body Guards 2''' without taking much damage. *The '''Golden Body Guards 2''' is not affected by any buff or debuff. *The '''Golden Body Guards 2''' will struggle against any enemy with abilities that damage units, because of its low health. **For example, if the [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] uses its ''Stomp'' attack, and a '''Golden Body Guards 2''' is caught in the attack, it is instantly killed. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''13 May 2022''' -
